disruptions.description: HIGHBURY GROVE N5: ROUTES 19/N19 from 08:00, Monday 20 July to 18:00, Friday 20 November 2026 is diverted in both directions due to water main replacement works by Thames Water. Towards Finsbury Park, buses are diverted from Highbury Corner via Holloway Road, Seven Sisters Road, and Station Place. Stops between 'Highbury Corner' (F) and 'Finsbury Park Interchange' (AP) will not be served. Buses towards Islington are diverted via Rock Street, Blackstock Road, Seven Sister's Road, Isledon Road, Tollington Road, and Holloway Road. Stops between 'Finsbury Park Interchange' (G) and 'Upper Street/Laycock Street' (G) will not be served. Please allow extra time for your journeys.

caveats.text: Unlimited bus and tram journeys within one hour.

Fares between two stations may vary depending on the direction of travel, time of day and day of the week.

We charge higher fares at the busiest times of the day (usually between 06:30 and 09:30, and between 16:00 and 19:00, Monday to Friday).

When you pay as you go, you must touch your contactless or Oyster card on a yellow reader at the start and end of your journey.

Some journeys are charged via Zone 1 regardless of the route taken.

If your journey avoids Zone 1 and you see a pink card reader when changing trains, touch your contactless or Oyster card on it to pay the right fare.
The price shown is a single adult pay as you go fare.
